plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 20% to lower concentration.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) to 15% for stability.
Hold remaining positions to preserve capital.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced risk.
conservative.read: This plan aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and focusing on income and broad indices, leading to lower potential drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to reduce risk.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 20% to address concentration.
Add a new high-scoring tech name (META) for growth potential.
Maintain a mix of broad index, quality tech, and reduced leverage.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This plan targets around 2.5% per month with a risk-first approach. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name, aiming for controlled growth with moderate drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) for amplified gains.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 15% to concentrate capital.
Add new high-scoring tech names (META, CRDO) for aggressive growth.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for maximum potential return.
Expect higher volatility and potential for larger drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This plan targets aggressive growth around 4% per month, accepting significantly higher risk. It leverages up on existing positions and adds new high-potential names, but this amplifies both gains and losses, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay.

moves.note: Reduce broad index for income focus

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names to cut risk.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 20% to prioritize income.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) to 40% for steady distributions.
This plan focuses on generating reliable monthly income.
Capital preservation is prioritized over aggressive growth.
income.read: This plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on stable income generation. It minimizes risk by eliminating leverage and volatile single stocks, prioritizing income-producing ETFs for consistent distributions, though NAV can still fluctuate.
